description: Beyond the paper. The paper's largest simulated size is m=30, where the Appendix B budget already covers only 0.2% of the space. At m=38 it covers 1e-05, so % optimal goes to zero and mean relative error becomes the metric -- the same shift the paper's own TSP m=29 row shows. Tests whether the click-density result survives when the search is a vanishing fraction of the space, or whether it was an artifact of the regime where the budget is still appreciable. Distinguishable photons, no multi-photon interference.
